name: 蘇莉芸
objective: The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.

Second week: Thermochemistry: Energy in Chemical Reactions
Third week: Entropy, Free Energy, and the Second Law of Thermodynamics
Fourth week: Entropy, Free Energy, and the Second Law of Thermodynamics
Fifth week: Entropy, Free Energy, and the Second Law of Thermodynamics
Sixth week: mid-term exam
Seventh week: Physical Equilibrium
Eighth week: Chemical Equilibrium
Ninth week: Mid-term exam
Tenth week: Chemical Equilibrium
Eleventh week: Acids and Bases
Twelfth week: mid-term exam
Thirteenth week: Acid-Base Equilibria and Solubility
Fourteenth week: Acid-Base Equilibria and Solubility
Fifteenth week: Electrochemistry
Sixteenth week: Electrochemistry
Seventeenth week: Chemical Kinetics
Eighteenth week: Final exam

The schedule is dependent on the actual progress of the lesson.
